label: GO after a rewarded rare a2->S1 transition (preceded by another reward), late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (never at D1 or D2), with zero activations before episode trial ~70; 99% of firing is when the previous trial chose a2, went rare to S1 and was rewarded (prev_common==0 for 89% of the mass, the rest mostly at the window start where history is unknown). Requiring the trial before that to also have been rewarded keeps all of the recall and raises precision. The model then nearly always picks a2 again (model_act==2 for 99.7%, policy logit strongly favouring a2, value low < 7.1); that is a model-free-style stay after a rare reward, but adding model_act only raises precision slightly. Magnitude grows along runs of repeated rewarded a2->S1 rare trials (the top windows show 0.06 -> 0.68 -> 0.92 -> 1.0 across consecutive rewarded rare trials while S1 is good). Never fires after a1, after common transitions, or after unrewarded trials. Precision stays low (~0.3) because many matching GO steps are silent; the late-episode restriction is a real but unexplained (time-in-episode) factor. Only observed variables are used.
